decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical FindFirst/FindNext buffer layout.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND DIR, PATH2 and TFOR and several DOS modules include find.inc; DIR and PATH2 use find_buf_pname, and DIR also uses find_buf_attr.
The prior DIR comparison matched 2114 non-relocation bytes and 78 internal branches at an inferred target location (review 122).
The prior PATH2 comparison matched 353 non-relocation bytes and one internal branch at an inferred target location (review 136).
limitations: These module comparisons exclude relocation bytes and cover only exercised fields; inferred target ranges and full COMMAND.COM identity require final linking.
